title: Literature synthesis to status spine
obligation: Turn a source-bounded literature search into a dated theorem-and-status ledger with unresolved conflicts and novelty prohibitions.
rejection_policy: Reject status claims without a dated search boundary and source locator.
Reject survey language promoted beyond the cited theorem hypotheses.
Reject novelty claims while unresolved priority, terminology, or equivalence conflicts remain.
mathcert_route: check each status-spine node against the cited theorem statement
preserve unresolved conflicts and dependency debt
certify only source correspondence and bounded status assertions
claim_boundary: A literature status spine records what the audited sources support at the stated cutoff; it neither proves an open theorem nor establishes novelty by itself.
